title: Group Anagrams
summary: Put words that are anagrams of each other into the same group.

tests.explain: listen, silent and enlist use the same six letters; google and gogole match; cat and act match. Groups, and the words inside them, may come in any order.
The empty string forms a group of its own.

hints: Comparing every pair of words is slow. Instead, can you give every word a key so that anagrams get the same key?
Sorting a word's letters gives such a key: "listen" and "silent" both become "eilnst".
Use a Map from key to an array of words. Push each word into its key's array, then return the map's values.

complexity.time: O(n · k log k): n words of length up to k, each sorted once (O(n · k) with a letter-count key)
complexity.space: O(n · k): every word is stored once in the map
